other_conditions: The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
The applicant must have a bank account.
The applicant must be one of the first two girl children of the family.
The applicant must be a girl born on or after 02-08-2019.
benefits_summary: Cash assistance of ₹4,000 at 1st standard admission, ₹6,000 at 9th standard admission, and ₹1,00,000 at age 18 for higher education or marriage.
